items.title: Wallace Davenport Interview, 1995-11-14
items.q: Do you remember any other recordings you made here in New Orleans, besides Roy Charles?

ctx.x: I'm more than sure that's what the reason. Yeah. I'm more than sure that's what the reason. I'm just looking over recordings now.
Do you remember any other recordings you made here in New Orleans, besides Roy Charles?
Oh yeah. I recorded with my band.
